verdict.rationale: Antigravity documents Rules, which are user-defined constraints the agent follows at local and global levels. Rules have activation modes including Always On and Glob, which fits project-level coding standards. However, the evidence never says rules live in a project instructions file or gives a file name, location or format, and skills (SKILL.md) are task-specific rather than project-wide conventions. Missing for 10: documentation that rules are a file committed in the repo (name, location, format), examples of coding-standard rules, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the agent follows them.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a project instructions file to set coding standards and conventions the agent follows

citations.quote: Rules are manually defined constraints for the Agent to follow, at both the local and global levels.
At the rule level you can define how a rule should be activated: Manual... Always On... Model Decision... Glob
